_comment: Pre-registration for scripts/run-callgraph-accuracy.mjs (#976). Committed BEFORE the harness was run on any repository listed under `repos`; the prose is benchmarks/CALLGRAPH_ACCURACY_PROTOCOL.md. The harness reads this file, records its sha256 in the report and refuses --save when it differs from the committed copy. A change after the first run is a deviation: add it to the Deviation log in the prose protocol with its date and reason, and keep the first run's numbers in the report history. Never edit a value here to make a result look better.

system.under_test: buildCallGraph(cwd) from src/graph/call-graph.js, zero config, on a git archive copy of the pinned commit
system.reference: caller-to-callee edges derived from a SCIP index of the same copy (compiler-derived, not ground truth)

go.note: needs a Go toolchain; run only if it can be installed into a scratch directory without a system install

java.note: needs a supported JDK and a working build of the pinned repository

typescriptProject.typescript: use the repository's own root tsconfig.json unchanged
typescriptProject.javascript: replace any tsconfig.json in the measurement copy with `javascriptConfig`

substitution: none: a repository whose indexer fails, or runs past `indexTimeoutMinutes`, is reported unmeasured with the reason and is not replaced

repos: sigmap (src/ of this repository, as JavaScript)
development.why: The reference deriver was built and debugged on repositories that are not in `repos`, so no rule was tuned on a measured repository.

edge.identity: <repo-relative path>#<bare name>, the node id buildCallGraph uses; callerId -> calleeId, directed, self edges dropped
edge.callSite: the next non-blank character after the reference is '(' once a balanced <...> on the same line has been skipped

universe.primary: edges whose caller file and callee file are both in U = (files with at least one definition in buildCallGraph) intersect (documents of the SCIP index)
universe.secondary: every reference edge between SCIP documents, whatever the graph walked (scope-inclusive recall)

metrics.precision: |graph edges in U that are also reference edges| / |graph edges in U|
metrics.recall: |reference edges in U that are also graph edges| / |reference edges in U|
metrics.pooling: micro-average over the repositories of a language group
metrics.fileLevel: undirected file pairs, caller file != callee file, on both sides

threshold.name: receiver-only method recall
threshold.statistic: pooled in-scope recall of reference edges of kind `method` whose sites are all `self` or `receiver` (no bare site)
threshold.applies: per language group with at least `minSample` such reference edges
threshold.if_below: a spike is warranted for a zero-dependency receiver-type pass that extends buildTypeMap (no type checker, no Tree-sitter) for that language
threshold.spikeAcceptance: the pass is kept only if it raises receiver-only method recall by at least 20 points in that language and lowers overall precision by no more than 2 points, both measured by this harness on the same repositories

predictions.claim: receiver-only method recall is below 15% in typescript, javascript, python and go, because buildCallGraph resolves `.name(` calls through a receiver type only for Java (typeMap is built only for JAVA_EXTS)
recall of `function` edges with a bare site is between 50% and 90% in every measured group
overall precision is between 50% and 90% in every measured group, driven by calls that match a same-named definition that is not the one the compiler resolved
`constructor` recall is below 10% in typescript, javascript and python, because classes are not nodes of the graph
in java, receiver-only method recall is higher than in any other group but still below 70%
